Start Here

New to the game, or new to thinking about it competitively? Read these in order.

  1. Starter Guide What the game is, and what you should be doing in a match.
  2. HUD Reading the screen: cooldowns, meters, and what the numbers mean.
  3. Fundamentals Spacing, timing, and the habits that decide most matches.
  4. Frame Data Startup, active and recovery — how to read every move page on this wiki.
  5. Evasive I-frames, dodging, and getting out of trouble.
  6. M1 Trading The 4-frame rule, and who wins when two attacks land together.

How to Contribute

Anyone signed in can propose an edit. A reviewer checks it before it goes live, so there is nothing you can break.

  1. Sign in Use the button at the bottom of the sidebar.
  2. Open a page and press EDIT Every character and system page has one.
  3. Follow the Writing Guide House style, and how frame data should be recorded.
  4. Track your submissions See what was approved, and what a reviewer asked about.
